title.en: Create a COMP shared cell (lock not executed)

body.zh: 由各自的 lock 解锁

label.en: new COMP cell(s) (several per tx allowed)

label.zh: lock.args 字节布局（40B，输入与后继必须逐字节相同）
label.en: lock.args byte layout (40B, byte-identical in input and successor)

role.zh: 应用状态 / 频道标识，合约不解释其内容
role.en: application state / channel id; opaque to the lock

cons.zh: args 总长 = 40；后继 lock 不可改

role.zh: 单次转换 COMP cell 最多可损失的 capacity（shannon）
role.en: max capacity the COMP cell may lose per transition (shannon)

cons.zh: 后继 capacity + max_fee ≥ 输入 capacity

note.zh: 示例：deployment.json 的 sharedCell.lockArgs（共享 cell #0）

cond.zh: 本合约不检查：输出上的 lock 在被花费前不会执行
cond.en: not checked by this contract: an output lock does not run until it is spent

note.zh: 非合约规则：若创建时 args ≠ 40 字节或带了 type，该 cell 以后每次花费都会失败（6 / 10），等于永久锁死。测试网上有一次建 10 个、40 个 COMP cell 的创建交易，例如 0x6a2af0eb…7a15。
note.en: Not a contract rule: if a cell is created with args ≠ 40 bytes or with a type, every later spend fails (6 / 10), locking it forever. Testnet has creation txs making 10 or 40 COMP cells at once, e.g. 0x6a2af0eb…7a15.

title.zh: 匿名消息 / 更新（任何人可发）

label.zh: COMP 共享 cell（group 输入，唯一）
label.en: COMP shared cell (group input, the only one)

body.zh:
COMP 代码 cell（Type ID 单例）
0x54d0bc54…db64:0 dep_type code
body.en:
COMP code cell (Type ID singleton)
0x54d0bc54…db64:0 dep_type code

body.zh: 不能再有任何 COMP lock 输出

note.zh: 效果：在区块 H 创建的 COMP cell 最早在 H+1 才能被花费，每条 cell 谱系每个区块最多一次转换（不是全局配额）。
note.en: Effect: a COMP cell created in block H is first spendable in H+1, so each cell lineage advances at most once per block (not a global quota).

role.zh: 压缩 SEC1 secp256k1 公钥（0x02/0x03 ‖ x），与 CKB 地址无关；可省略 0x，大小写 hex 都接受
role.en: compressed SEC1 secp256k1 key (0x02/0x03 ‖ x), independent of CKB addresses; 0x optional, either hex case accepted

cons.zh: 字符串或 null；与 signature 同时存在 / 同时缺省；长度恰好 33 字节
cons.en: string or null; present together with signature; exactly 33 bytes

cons.zh: 恢复出的压缩公钥必须等于 public_key
cons.en: recovered compressed key must equal public_key

role.zh: 应用载荷，必须是 object 或 array；签名时按原样字节参与哈希
role.en: application payload, object or array; hashed as raw bytes when signed

cons.zh: 签名消息必须存在；三个已知键都不可重复
cons.en: required for signed messages; none of the three known keys may repeat

note.zh: 示例来自测试网 tx 0xac085cab…8d01（匿名）与 0x07a093a2…d50b（签名）。未知顶层键会被语法校验后忽略。
note.en: Examples from testnet tx 0xac085cab…8d01 (anonymous) and 0x07a093a2…d50b (signed). Unknown top-level keys are syntax-checked then ignored.

cond.zh: 没有任何“回收 / 关闭”路径：COMP cell 只要存在就只能被续写
cond.en: no reclaim / close path: a COMP cell can only be continued, never removed

note.zh: 仓库 scripts/reclaim.mjs 只能回收普通 cell，不能绕过本合约（未逐行核对脚本）。max_fee 只限制单次损失，不限制总损失：反复转换可以把 capacity 逐步消耗到最低占用。
note.en: The repo's scripts/reclaim.mjs cannot bypass this lock (script not reviewed line by line). max_fee bounds per-transition loss only; repeated transitions can drain capacity down to the occupied minimum.

notes.zh: 错误码来自 main.rs 的 enum Error（#[repr(i8)]）：1 IndexOutOfBound、2 ItemMissing、3 LengthNotEnough、4 Encoding、6 ArgsEncoding、7 MultipleLockGroups、8 InvalidInputCount、9 InvalidSuccessorCount、10 TypeScriptNotAllowed、11 LockMismatch、12 CapacityExceeded、13 InvalidIdentity、14 WitnessFormat、15 SignatureInvalid、16 InvalidSince。5 没有定义；1–3 在源码里从不返回，只有 4 用于 syscall 失败。
notes.en: Error codes from enum Error in main.rs (#[repr(i8)]): 1 IndexOutOfBound, 2 ItemMissing, 3 LengthNotEnough, 4 Encoding, 6 ArgsEncoding, 7 MultipleLockGroups, 8 InvalidInputCount, 9 InvalidSuccessorCount, 10 TypeScriptNotAllowed, 11 LockMismatch, 12 CapacityExceeded, 13 InvalidIdentity, 14 WitnessFormat, 15 SignatureInvalid, 16 InvalidSince. 5 is unused; 1–3 are never returned, only 4 is used for syscall failures.

notes.zh: 检查顺序（与 enum 顺序不同）：6 args → 8 group 输入数 → 16 since → 7 COMP 输入数 → 9 后继数 → 10 type → 11 lock → 12 capacity → 14/13/15 witness。所以同时违反多条时报最先命中的那个，例如两个同 lock 的 COMP 输入报 8 而不是 7。
notes.en: Check order (differs from the enum order): 6 args → 8 group input count → 16 since → 7 COMP input count → 9 successor count → 10 type → 11 lock → 12 capacity → 14/13/15 witness. When several rules fail, the first one wins, e.g. two COMP inputs with the same lock fail with 8, not 7.

notes.zh: 注释 / 文档与代码不一致：README 写 message_bytes = [0;65] ‖ utf8(compact_json(extensions))，main.rs 注释写 canonical_encode(...)，但代码直接哈希 witness 里 extensions 的原始字节，不做压缩或规范化（docs/contract-design.md 写的 raw_json(extensions) 才对）。签名方必须对写进 witness 的原样字节签名。README 的“Validation rules”列表顺序也与实际检查顺序不同（since 列在第 8 条，实际第 3 个检查）。
notes.en: Comment / doc vs code: README says message_bytes = [0;65] ‖ utf8(compact_json(extensions)) and the main.rs comment says canonical_encode(...), but the code hashes the raw extensions bytes exactly as they appear in the witness, with no compaction or canonicalization (docs/contract-design.md's raw_json(extensions) is the accurate one). Signers must sign the exact bytes written to the witness. README's "Validation rules" list is also not in execution order (since is rule 8 there but the 3rd check in code).

notes.zh: 空 witness（0x）不是“没有 witness”：ckb-std load_witness_args 解析空字节失败 → 14。只有 witness 槽位不存在（下标越界）或 WitnessArgs.lock 为 None / 空才算匿名。
notes.en: An empty witness (0x) is not "no witness": ckb-std load_witness_args fails to parse empty bytes → 14. Only a missing witness slot (index out of bound) or a None / empty WitnessArgs.lock counts as anonymous.

notes.zh: extensions.payload 的格式（comp text、comp-wall v1 JSON、v2 "CW2:"+base64 二进制，见 docs/wall-binary-payload.md）全是前端约定，链上合约不检查；解码器只显示 protocol / version / type 和 payload 长度。
notes.en: The extensions.payload formats (comp text, comp-wall v1 JSON, v2 "CW2:"+base64 binary per docs/wall-binary-payload.md) are frontend conventions; the on-chain lock does not check them. The decoder only shows protocol / version / type and the payload length.

notes.zh: 部署：COMP lock 的 code_hash 是 Type ID 脚本哈希（hash_type type），代码 cell 在 0x54d0bc54…db64:0（2026-08-21 升级，dataHash 0x47cf5e… → 0x81dae1…）。升级前（区块 22154878 之前）的测试网交易 since = 0，旧二进制不要求 since；解码器按当前规则会把它们标成 16。README 里的 v0.1 data2 部署（0x43fd…12d9）是旧 witness 格式，未收录。
notes.en: Deployment: the COMP lock code_hash is the Type ID script hash (hash_type type); the code cell is 0x54d0bc54…db64:0 (upgraded 2026-08-21, dataHash 0x47cf5e… → 0x81dae1…). Testnet txs before the upgrade (block < 22154878) use since = 0, which the old binary did not require; the decoder flags them with 16 under the current rules. The README's v0.1 data2 deployment (0x43fd…12d9) uses the old witness schema and is not included.

notes.zh: 二进制未核验：链上 data_hash 与 deployment.json 记录一致，但仓库没有提交二进制或 checksum；本地用 rust 1.95.0 + Makefile 的 RUSTFLAGS 在 fd2370a 重编译得到 131672 字节，与链上 131984 字节不同，未能复现。解码器离线检查 args、since、COMP 输入/输出数、type、lock、capacity、witness JSON 结构；secp256k1 恢复为 NOT_CHECKED（会显示 signing_digest）。
notes.en: Binary unverified: the on-chain data_hash matches the deployment.json record, but the repo commits no binary or checksum; rebuilding fd2370a locally with rust 1.95.0 and the Makefile RUSTFLAGS gave 131672 bytes vs 131984 on chain, so the build was not reproduced. The decoder checks args, since, COMP input/output counts, type, lock, capacity and witness JSON shape offline; secp256k1 recovery is NOT_CHECKED (signing_digest is shown).
